_meta.notes: Simplified data structure matching the Vent component. Per-wind copy is only the route recommendation + an optional flourish. All other UI state (tier label, direction letter) is derived from raw API values.

speedTiers._comment: Maps wind speed in km/h to a tier label. Use minKmh <= speed < maxKmh (half-open, lower-inclusive). API may return m/s — convert before lookup: kmh = ms * 3.6.

speedTiersFeminine._comment: Use these when the wind name is grammatically feminine (Tramuntana / Tramontane). All other winds use the masculine forms above. Note: when the UI label is the standalone word 'Vent' (masculine in Catalan/French, neutral in English/Spanish), always use the masculine forms.

tierColors._comment: Color of the tier label text ('Vent suau' etc.). Maps to a design token. Tier color escalates with speed regardless of direction — direction-specific risk is communicated via the recommendation text and the safety override.

calmState._comment: When wind speed is below this threshold, render this banner. Wind direction is meaningless at these speeds. The Rive rose should show its resting state with no active point.

recommendation.es: Cualquier ruta es una buena opción.
recommendation.en: Any route is a good choice.
recommendation.fr: N'importe quel itinéraire est une bonne option.

safetyOverride._comment: When wind speed exceeds this threshold from any direction, override the per-wind recommendation. The tier label still shows 'Vent molt fort' (or feminine), but in danger color.

recommendation.ca: Condicions massa fortes per sortir avui.
recommendation.es: Condiciones demasiado fuertes para salir hoy.
recommendation.en: Conditions too strong to paddle today.
recommendation.fr: Conditions trop fortes pour sortir aujourd'hui.

flourish.ca: El vent t'empeny mar endins, no t'allunyis.
flourish.es: El viento te empuja mar adentro, no te alejes.
flourish.en: The wind pushes you out to sea, stay close.
flourish.fr: Le vent te pousse vers le large, ne t'éloigne pas.

flourish.ca: Aixeca onatge a l'entrada de la cala.
flourish.es: Levanta oleaje en la entrada de la cala.
flourish.en: Builds waves at the cove entrance.
flourish.fr: Lève la houle à l'entrée de la crique.

recommendation.ca: Qualsevol ruta, queda't a prop de la costa.
recommendation.es: Cualquier ruta, quédate cerca de la costa.
recommendation.en: Either route, stay close to the shore.
recommendation.fr: N'importe quel itinéraire, reste près de la côte.

flourish.ca: El vent de mar entra directament a la cala.
flourish.es: El viento de mar entra directamente en la cala.
flourish.en: The sea breeze blows straight into the cove.
flourish.fr: Le vent de mer entre directement dans la crique.
Chaud et humide, prends de l'eau.

flourish.ca: Et porta de tornada a la platja.
flourish.es: Te lleva de vuelta a la playa.
flourish.en: Carries you back to the beach.
flourish.fr: Il te ramène jusqu'à la plage.

flourish.ca: Brisa de tarda, surt al matí si vols tranquil·litat.
flourish.es: Brisa de tarde, sal por la mañana si quieres tranquilidad.
flourish.en: Afternoon breeze, paddle in the morning for calmer water.
flourish.fr: Brise d'après-midi, sors le matin pour une eau plus calme.

recommendation.ca: Ruta sud, queda't a prop de la costa.
recommendation.es: Ruta sur, quédate cerca de la costa.
recommendation.en: South route, stay close to the shore.
recommendation.fr: Itinéraire sud, reste près de la côte.

flourish.ca: Sembla un mirall, però t'empeny mar endins.
flourish.es: Parece un espejo, pero te empuja mar adentro.
flourish.en: Looks like a mirror, but pushes you out to sea.
flourish.fr: Ressemble à un miroir, mais te pousse vers le large.

flourish.ca: Sec i ratxejat, imprevisible fora de la cala.
flourish.es: Seco y racheado, impredecible fuera de la cala.
flourish.en: Dry and gusty, unpredictable outside the cove.
flourish.fr: Sec et rafaleux, imprévisible hors de la crique.

displayTemplate._comment: How the component renders. The Rive rose handles direction visually. The text below has two lines.
resolutionOrder: 1. If speed < calmState.triggerKmh (1 km/h) → render calmState (no direction shown, Rive rose idle)
2. Else if speed >= safetyOverride.triggerKmh (38 km/h) → render with wind.cardinalLetter + 'Vent molt fort' in danger color + safetyOverride.recommendation
3. Else → render per-wind: cardinal letter + 'Vent {tier}' in tier color + wind.recommendation (+ optional flourish)
